Class EquipCabin

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Cabin
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.EquipCabin
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class EquipCabin extends Cabin
Represents a cabin tile capable of hosting crew members, including aliens. It supports human crew, brown aliens, and purple aliens depending on adjacent life support systems.
